NOVAPAY | Customer Finance Operations

  Internal policy reference • Document 1 of 2 • Version 1.4 • Effective 1 October 2026

  Fictional training document for document-comparison and contradiction-detection evaluation. NovaPay is a fictional
  organization; no policy below describes a real financial institution.


 Scope and interpretation
 These rules describe retail customer operations in India. Unless a section specifies otherwise, statements
 apply to verified retail customers using NovaPay services as of the effective date above. Monetary
 amounts are in Indian rupees (INR).

 1. Service Availability
 The NovaPay customer portal is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Planned maintenance is
 announced at least 48 hours in advance.

 2. Standard Transfer Limit
 For verified retail customers, the maximum single domestic bank transfer is INR 100,000.

 3. Refund Processing
 Approved card payment refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 business days.

 4. Support Hours
 Live chat support is available Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM IST.

 5. Two-Factor Authentication
 Two-factor authentication is mandatory for every transfer above INR 10,000.

 6. Account Closure Fee
 No account closure fee is charged to retail customers, regardless of how long the account has been
 open.

 7. Failed Transaction Reversal
 A failed UPI transaction is automatically reversed within 24 hours after the failure is confirmed.

 8. Monthly Statement Delivery
 Monthly account statements are issued electronically on the third calendar day of each month.

 9. Dispute Filing Window
 Customers may raise a card transaction dispute up to 60 calendar days after the transaction date.

 10. Debit Card Replacement
 The first replacement of a lost debit card in a calendar year is free of charge.

 11. Minimum Account Balance
 NovaPay Basic Savings accounts have no minimum balance requirement.

 12. Complaint Resolution Target
 Standard customer complaints are targeted for resolution within 7 business days of receiving complete
 information.

 13. International Transfer Eligibility
 International outward transfers are available to customers after full KYC verification.

 14. Inactive Account Definition
 A retail account is classified as inactive after 12 consecutive months without a customer-initiated
 transaction.

 15. Transaction Alert Delivery
 Customers receive an SMS or push alert for every successful card purchase, subject to notification
 service availability.
